text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
BULKERS - Khudozhnik Gabashvili - (built 1979) 24,285 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $2 million for delivery "as is" in the Black Sea.
Samjohn Mariner - (built 1975) 54,720 dwt sold for $5 million.
Bunga Suria - (built 1979) 48,450 dwt sold for $19 million "en bloc" to undisclosed.
Flensburger No: 691 - (built 1996) 41,580 dwt sold to $42 million to undisclosed buyers.
TWEENDECKERS - Vast Jollity - (built 1977) 24,300 dwt sold for $5 million.
Triatic Power - (built 1979) 17,935 sold at auction for $2.05 million to German buyers.
Conor - (built 1978) sold for $4.5 million to Greek buyers.
SOLD FOR DEMOLITION - Rea - (built 1973) 60,107 dwt sold for $196 per ldt delivery India.
Jalavijaya - (built 1975) 53,438 dwt sold for $195 delivery India.
Alfa - (built 1974) 54,256 dwt sold for $198 delivery Karachi/Bangladesh options.
Pivot - (built 1975) 232,104 dwt sold for $206 with option for delivery Bangladesh range.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to inspection, survey or other conditions.
